# dsh-go v0.1.4

This release consolidates the latest Registry V4, runtime descriptor, deployment convergence, and Marketplace package hardening work.

## Highlights

- Enforce Runtime Descriptor authority fail-closed across Registry V4 and Resolver V2.
- Preserve runtime descriptor fields through package resolution and lifecycle flows.
- Resolve production identity from the real three-platform deployment state so control-plane-only commits do not cause false Monitor failures.
- Require Cloudflare Pages, GitHub Pages, and Tencent EdgeOne to converge on the same deployment SHA and Registry V4 revision.
- Refresh Registry V4 discovery data and keep Package Protocol V2 release artifacts immutable and reproducible.
- Release `coeasy/dsh-go-marketplace` and `coeasy/dsh-go-marketplace-plugin` as version `0.1.4`.

## Validation

Release candidates must pass the repository CI, architecture/contract checks, package lifecycle coverage, platform release checks, and production convergence gates before publication.
